verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's first-party docs say a scheduling link can connect to a Stripe product and require payment before the meeting time is reserved. Clients pay as they book, and the meeting only lands on the calendar once payment succeeds. Supporting features include Stripe Tax, any Stripe payment method, coupon codes, and managing offerings and prices natively inside SavvyCal. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the payment-at-booking flow, since all evidence is vendor-claimed.
